task_objective: Implement exact DuckDB query-error position navigation from docs/plans/2026-08-22_error-position-navigation.md.
tests_added: DuckDB LINE/caret parser accepts exact parser, binder, and catalog excerpts and rejects incomplete or elided excerpts.
SqlEditor public diagnostic navigation clamps coordinates, safely declines ambiguous Unicode positions, and clears on edit.
Messages activation emits only stored navigation payloads.
MainWindow maps selected-statement errors to the originating tab and rejects positionless, mismatched, and stale targets.
Selected SQL following a non-ASCII character converts QScintilla UTF-8 byte offsets before source navigation.

Mouse and keyboard Messages activation use real QListWidget input, while translated, parameterized, multi-statement, saved-query, Spark, tab-expanded, Unicode-ambiguous, and closed-tab errors remain non-navigable.
design_decisions: Navigation data remains desktop-only; ExecutionRequest and QueryResult were not changed.

The parser and request mapping fail closed for missing carets, elision, tabs, Unicode before the target, changed documents, translated SQL, parameters, multi-statement requests, saved-query execution, and non-DuckDB engines.
The request origin records the source snapshot and adjusts the editor selection start for ExecutionRequestBuilder whitespace stripping.
A request origin converts the selected QScintilla UTF-8 byte offset to a Python codepoint offset only at a valid UTF-8 boundary; conversion failure leaves navigation unavailable.
Messages treats a real list-item mouse click and keyboard activation as navigation input, while a zero-delay guard prevents one platform activation gesture from emitting twice.
